start: Members page, button to import (or Settings, or the growth card); an Excel sheet with names, mobiles, plans and fees

steps.action: Open the import page
user_sees: Title 'Import members from Excel'
'Bring in your members from an Excel sheet or your old gym software'
Card 'Your file' with 'Nothing is saved until you check the list and tap Add.'
Buttons 'Choose file' and 'Download sample file'
must_not: Any member saved at this point
A page that needs a plan upgrade

steps.action: Tap 'Choose file' and pick the .xlsx
user_sees: 'Reading the file… a big sheet can take a few seconds.'
Then 'Which column is which' with a box per detail (name * and mobile *)
One line about the AI matching (owner only)
must_not: Names, mobiles or addresses sent to the AI in full (only masked column names and example shapes)
A frozen page with no word

steps.action: Check the column boxes, then read 'Check the list'
user_sees: Counts of rows to add, to skip and to check
Card 'Plans and payments': '<n> members come with their plan and its dates (<n> plan names), and ₹… already paid as receipts. Expiry reminders work for them from day one.'
must_not: A paid total that counts a running 'paid so far' twice
Rows with a bad mobile counted as ready

steps.action: Tap 'Add <n> members'
user_sees: 'Adding members…' with a progress bar
Then 'Import finished' and '<n> added, <n> skipped'
'<n> plans with their dates · <n> receipts · …'
Buttons to open Members, download skipped rows, start over
must_not: A member added twice
A receipt for money not in the file
WhatsApp or SMS sent to imported members
The Add button usable again while it runs

steps.action: Open Members
user_sees: The new members with their plans, end dates and dues
must_not: Members without the plan the file gave them
An expiry date shifted by a day

start: Other kinds: a CSV from old software where some members are already in the gym, and a file with several sheets; reached from Settings

steps.action: From Settings tap the import button, choose a .csv
user_sees: 'Which column is which'
'Column names are on row' box when the names are not on row 1
must_not: Dates like 15/08/2026 read as month 15
Wrong letters for Hindi names in a CSV

steps.action: In 'Check the list' read '<n> are already members of your gym (same mobile). For them:' and pick 'Fill in their blank details'
user_sees: Choices 'Skip them' and 'Fill in their blank details'
'Only empty details are filled in. Their name, mobile and joining date stay as they are.'
Button reads 'Add <a> members, update <b>' or 'Update <b> members'
must_not: An existing member's name, mobile or joining date overwritten
A second member with the same mobile

steps.action: Tap the button, then on 'Import finished' tap the next-sheet button
user_sees: '<n> added, <n> skipped, <n> filled in'
The next sheet opens at 'Which column is which'
must_not: The sheet just imported offered again
Rows of the first sheet added twice

steps.action: Choose a file over 5 MB
user_sees: 'That file is over 5 MB. It is too big for a member list. Pick the Excel or CSV file with your members.'
Back on 'Your file'
must_not: The browser hanging on a huge file
Any row saved

steps.action: Choose a file that is not a sheet (a photo, a PDF) or an empty sheet
user_sees: A plain red line saying the file could not be read or has no rows
'Choose file' usable again
must_not: A blank 'Check the list'
A raw error text

steps.action: Choose a sheet with rows missing a mobile, with 9-digit mobiles, repeated mobiles and an Aadhaar column
user_sees: 'Rows to check' with each row and a box to fix it, plus 'Skip row <n>'
The Aadhaar column marked as never imported ('ID numbers are never imported.')
The Add button counts only good rows
must_not: A member saved without a mobile
An Aadhaar or PAN number stored anywhere
Two members from the same mobile in one file

steps.action: Fix one row and tap its button; turn the internet off and tap Add
user_sees: 'Row <n> checked again.'
After Add: rows that could not be saved are listed under 'Rows to check' with 'Try again'
must_not: 'Import finished' counting rows that were not saved
A retry that adds the saved rows a second time

start: An import has just finished; 'Past imports' card under the page

steps.action: Read 'Past imports'
user_sees: Each import with its date and '<n> members · <n> plans with dates · <n> receipts'
Button 'Undo this import'
must_not: Imports of another branch in this list
An import already undone still listed

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import'
user_sees: What will go and what stays, with 'Yes, undo it' and a way to cancel
must_not: Anything removed before 'Yes, undo it'

steps.action: Tap 'Yes, undo it'
user_sees: Button 'Undoing…'
'Import undone: <n> members, <n> plans with dates, <n> receipts and <n> plan names removed.' plus what was kept
must_not: Members who checked in or paid since the import removed
Members from before the import removed
Money totals still counting removed receipts

steps.action: Import the same file again
user_sees: The same counts as the first time
must_not: 'already a member' for rows that were undone
Double receipts

steps.action: Undo with the internet off
user_sees: 'The import was not fully undone. Check the internet and tap Undo again. What is already removed stays removed.'
must_not: A success line for a half-done undo

start: A member sheet with Aadhaar, PAN, address and blood-group columns

steps.action: Choose the file and read 'Which column is which' and 'Other columns in your file'
user_sees: 'Aadhaar and PAN numbers are never imported.' on the first card
The ID columns shown as not kept
Other columns (locker number, blood group) offered as extra details with a name box
must_not: An ID number kept as an extra detail
ID numbers or full names sent to the AI column matcher

steps.action: Tick blood group as an extra detail, import, open a member
user_sees: The extra detail on the member's page under the name typed
must_not: Health-type details visible to roles that may not open the member
A detail kept that was not ticked

steps.action: Sign in as front desk and open the import page
user_sees: No 'Past imports' card and no AI line
Plans card says 'Only the owner can add plans and payments.'
must_not: Front desk able to undo an import or add receipts

start: Front desk signed in; Members page, import button; a sheet with names, mobiles and plans

steps.action: Open the import page and tap 'Choose file'
user_sees: Title 'Import members from Excel'
'Which column is which' filled by the panel's own rules (no AI line)
must_not: An AI request made for a staff session
A refusal to open the page

steps.action: Read 'Check the list' and the 'Plans and payments' card
user_sees: '<n> members have a plan in this file. Only the owner can add plans and payments. Members are added now. Plans are added when the owner imports the same file.'
must_not: A paid total or receipt count shown to staff
A button that says plans will be added

steps.action: Tap 'Add <n> members'
user_sees: 'Adding members…'
'Import finished' and '<n> added, <n> skipped'
A line that only the owner can add the plans and payments in this file
must_not: A membership or receipt saved by the staff session
Members saved with no word that their plans are still missing

steps.action: Open Members
user_sees: The new members, with no plan yet
must_not: Members shown as paid or active on a plan

start: Front desk signed in; import page

steps.action: Choose a file whose rows are all members already in the gym, each with a plan
user_sees: Add button greyed (nothing to add for staff: plans do not count for the front desk)
The 'Only the owner can add plans and payments.' card
must_not: A button 'Add <n> plans and payments' usable by staff

steps.action: Look for 'Past imports' and 'Undo this import'
user_sees: Neither is on the page for staff
must_not: Front desk able to undo an import

steps.action: Choose a file over 5 MB
user_sees: 'That file is over 5 MB. It is too big for a member list. Pick the Excel or CSV file with your members.'
must_not: Any row saved

start: Front desk has imported members; the owner then imports the same file

steps.action: On 'Import finished' tap the start-over button
user_sees: Back to 'Your file' with 'Choose file'
must_not: The finished import run again

steps.action: Choose the same file again as staff
user_sees: Every row counted as already a member; nothing to add
must_not: Second copies of the members

steps.action: Owner signs in and imports the same file
user_sees: '<n> members come with their plan and its dates…'
Button 'Add <n> plans and payments'
After it: '<n> plans with their dates · <n> receipts'
must_not: Second copies of the members staff added
Plans attached to the wrong member with a like name (matching is by mobile)

steps.action: Owner opens 'Past imports'
user_sees: The owner's import, with 'Undo this import'
must_not: Undo of the owner's import removing members used since

start: Front desk signed in; a sheet with Aadhaar and fee columns

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: 'Aadhaar and PAN numbers are never imported.'
ID columns not kept
must_not: An ID number stored
The sheet sent to the AI (owner only)

steps.action: Import and read the result
user_sees: Members added; the owner-only line about plans and payments
must_not: Fee amounts from the file saved as receipts by a staff session
Money figures of the gym shown that the front desk may not see
